name: Clan of Xymox
label: 4AD
lede: Two Nijmegen students with a Korg and a drum machine got a Dead Can Dance tour, two albums on 4AD and a John Peel session, then shortened their name and put a song on MTV. Ronny Moorings has kept Clan of Xymox going for four decades since.

eras.title: Silkscreen and a Korg MS-10
eras.text: Ronny Moorings and Anka Wolbert met as students in Nijmegen and started playing as a duo, swapping instruments between songs. A self-made EP and one chance meeting with Brendan Perry got them from the Netherlands onto 4AD.

years.src: Post-Punk.com: Subsequent Pleasures · Wikipedia: Clan of Xymox
years.h: Two students in Nijmegen, one bass, one monophonic synth
years.p: Moorings plays guitar and sings; Wolbert plays bass and a Korg MS-10 at the same time, over tape loops, a Casio and a drum machine.
years.xp: "While I had a bass guitar strapped around my neck and simultaneously hit the monophonic keyboard, Ronny played guitar and sang," Wolbert told Post-Punk.com. The name came from zymotic, of or causing fermentation; a German biography says they liked how it looked in capitals, like barbed wire.

years.src: Post-Punk.com: Subsequent Pleasures · Altvenger · Wikipedia: Clan of Xymox
years.p: Five songs cut on a 4-track TEAC, released as Xymox. Wolbert, who did silkscreen design at Amsterdam's Oktopus venue, prints the two-colour sleeves herself.
years.xp: "To me, releasing Subsequent Pleasures was making a statement we were serious about what we were doing," Wolbert said. Moorings, looking back, says it went out without much success.

years.cap: Ronny Moorings, Pieter Nooten and Anka Wolbert
years.src: Wikipedia: Ronny Moorings · Wikipedia: Clan of Xymox · Post-Punk.com: Post-Punk Podcast
years.h: Brendan Perry hears the EP and takes Xymox on tour
years.p: After a chance meeting, [[Dead Can Dance|ccda046a-2674-4f7d-97e6-f23d6c156432]]'s Perry invites them on his UK tour. Now in Amsterdam, the band has added Moorings' old flatmate Pieter Nooten and guitarist Frank Weyzig.

eras.title: Darkwave gets a name
eras.text: Clan of Xymox were 4AD's first signing since Dead Can Dance, and Ivo Watts-Russell produced the debut himself. John Peel had them in twice in 1985, and the term darkwave is credited to his description of them.

years.src: Wikipedia: Clan of Xymox (album) · Post-Punk.com: Post-Punk Podcast
years.h: Ivo produces the debut in Edinburgh
years.p: Recorded at Palladium Studios with Ivo producing, then remixed by [[John Fryer|17375716-41de-49a9-8b9c-64c71bb14742]] at Blackwing in London. Melody Maker called it "a nervous and brilliant record."
years.xp: All songs are credited to the three singer-songwriters. Fryer's remixes turned singles into club tracks, Moorings recalls. Later critics heard Joy Division and the Cure in it, and a template for goth's icy keyboards.

years.src: Wikipedia: Clan of Xymox · Post-Punk.com: Post-Punk Podcast
years.h: John Peel plays 7th Time and books two sessions
years.p: Wolbert sings 7th Time, the track Peel picks up. The band records Peel Sessions in June and November 1985, the recordings later tied to the coining of darkwave.

years.h: Medusa, the one critics call their peak
years.p: Co-produced with Fryer. Sounds said every track "sounds like the finale to a brooding epic overture"; Louise follows as a single in December.

years.src: Wikipedia: Medusa · Wikipedia: Clan of Xymox · Post-Punk.com: Subsequent Pleasures · Altvenger
years.h: Nooten makes Sleeps with the Fishes with Michael Brook
years.p: During a brief split, Nooten re-records two Medusa songs, After the Call and Theme I, with Canadian guitarist Michael Brook for a 4AD album of their own.
years.xp:
Moorings later told AlterNation the next album was "made entirely independently, without the rest of the musicians, who were then on vacation." Wolbert's version: Xymox "as a whole was greater than the sum of its parts."

That same year a re-recorded Muscoviet Mosquito, the first real song Moorings says he wrote, appears on the 4AD compilation Lonely Is an Eyesore.

eras.title: Xymox, now on MTV
eras.text: PolyGram was what every band wanted, Moorings says, and it delivered: shorter name, Tony Visconti strings, a Hot 100 single and 300,000 copies of Twist of Shadows. The hit was sung by Wolbert, and that's where the trouble started.

years.cap: Xymox ad in The Face for Obsession and Twist of Shadows, June 1989
years.src: Wikipedia: Twist of Shadows · Wikipedia: Ronny Moorings
years.h: Twist of Shadows gets Arditti Quartet strings and Visconti charts
years.p: Signed to PolyGram's Wing label and billed as Xymox, the band makes its best seller: over 300,000 copies worldwide. Obsession reaches No. 16 on Modern Rock Tracks.
years.xp: Peter Walsh produced; [[Tony Visconti|9472e6e4-3e13-430a-900d-6f075720a5c6]] arranged the strings, recorded at his Good Earth Studios. The album entered the Billboard 200 at No. 165. That year the band moved to London.

years.src: Wikipedia: Twist of Shadows · Post-Punk.com: Subsequent Pleasures
years.p: The third single from Twist of Shadows is the band's biggest US hit. Wolbert says its success set Moorings against her.
years.xp: In Wolbert's telling to Post-Punk.com, Moorings feared she was overshadowing him, and PolyGram wanting more songs with her vocals made it worse. Moorings has not told it that way in the interviews used here.

years.cap: Ronny Moorings backstage at the 9:30 Club, Washington DC, 1991
q: I felt I was walking a tightrope.
years.src: Post-Punk.com: Subsequent Pleasures · Wikipedia: Clan of Xymox
years.h: It blows up in a Portland dressing room
years.p: Three shows from the end of the Phoenix tour, Wolbert says, things exploded backstage in Portland. She finishes the tour, then she and Nooten leave over the band's direction.
years.xp: Wolbert moved to New York and then London, worked with Toni Halliday of Curve, and took a 4AD development deal in 1994. She says Moorings has played down her part in the band since.

eras.title: Acid house, then nothing
eras.text: Without Wolbert and Nooten, Moorings left PolyGram and chased UK acid house just as America went grunge. He later said he'd lost his sense of direction.

years.cap: Xymox in a Mercury promo photo
years.p: Released independently and still as Xymox, it and 1993's Headclouds sell poorly in the US. In March, Moorings also cuts Yokan with Japanese singer Atsushi Sakurai.
years.xp: Moorings to Altvenger: in the early '90s he "lost sense of direction," trying to get away from his '80s origins.

years.h: Frank Weyzig, the last original besides Moorings, leaves
years.p: After a 1994 tour with a changing live band, including his girlfriend [[Mojca Zugna|74154d67-7107-4d8f-85b3-3e6f5f04398a]], Moorings moves back to the Netherlands and stops writing for three years.

eras.title: Clan again, in Germany
eras.text: With goth and industrial back in fashion, Moorings restored the full name, moved to Germany and found a long-term home at Metropolis Records. 4AD reissued the first two albums in America.

years.cap: Clan of Xymox press photo for Hidden Faces, 1997
years.h: The name Clan of Xymox comes back for Hidden Faces
years.p: Moorings relocates to Germany, then the center of industrial music, and signs with the US label Tess; Metropolis follows in 1998.

years.h: 4AD reissues Clan of Xymox and Medusa in the US
years.p: The band tours the United States the following year.

eras.title: Back to the 4AD sound
eras.text: Moorings's records drifted toward electro and industrial before swinging back to the layered sound of the early albums. Film soundtracks and a new generation of darkwave bands kept the old songs in circulation.

years.h: In Love We Trust returns to the layered 4AD sound
years.p: Released on Trisol, the album turns away from the industrial edge of the 2000s records toward the textures of Medusa.

years.cap: Clan of Xymox at Amphi festival, Cologne
years.h: David Fincher puts In Your Arms Again in The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
years.p: The Darkest Hour track lands on the soundtrack; in 2014 three Xymox songs turn up in the film The Guest.

years.h: Limbo is a concept album about the pandemic
years.p: Post-Punk.com's Alice Teeple called it "a masterstroke of modern goth rock."

years.cap: Ronny Moorings and the current Clan of Xymox
years.h: Exodus, then the Blood of Christ EP six months later
years.p: More than four decades in, Moorings is still the one constant, with a live band that includes Zugna and guitarist Mario Usai.
